description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 4726/APP/2022/3782, dated 11-04-2023 (Erection of a single storey extension to create a spa centre) to retain existing single storey store and reduce the size of the proposed extension entrance area.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out except in complete accordance with the details shown on the submitted plans numbered
and shall thereafter be retained/maintained for as long as the development remains in existence.
To ensure the development complies with the provisions of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012), Part 2 (2020) and the London Plan (2021).

The retained outbuilding, as shown on drawing A101 Rev P1, shall be used only for purposes ancillary to the spa/hotel use and shall not be occupied as a separate unit of accommodation or for any other independent use.

To avoid any future fragmentation of the curtilage or the creation of a separate residential or business use, so as to protect the amenity of adjoining residential properties in accordance with Policies DMHB 11, DMHB 18, DMHD 2 and DMT 6 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (January 2020).

Notwithstanding the non-material amendment hereby approved, other than condition 2 which is superseded by the above condition, and new condition 8, all other conditions relating to Planning Permission Ref: 4726/APP/2022/3782, dated 11/04/2023 must be discharged/adhered to as per that permission.
